attempts.text:
**The window starts in a persistent run.** Columns 0 to 16 are spine, carried by 91 to 100% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 17% of calls. The model names 90% of genes there on average, but at column 9, `yjjQ`, it names only 18% and hesitates 0.93 bits.

**Then the graph opens at `lgoR` and `lgoT`**, columns 17 and 18, fork and variable columns in a region of plasticity in 55 to 56% of calls. Column 19, `tsr`, is spine again, 91% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 56% of calls, named 87%.

**The long fork and variable stretch runs from column 20 to 79**, in a region of plasticity in 34 to 70% of calls, named 81% on average. A second branch of 11 families, `hpaR` to the monooxygenase, [[homoprotocatechuate degradation]], runs through columns 20 to 30, carried by 28 to 33% of chromosomes. Smaller branches carry `mrr` to `hsdM` at columns 34 to 36, the KilA-N protein to the LexA regulator at 37 to 39, and `yfdP` to `yfdR` at 48 to 50.

**The model hesitates most at column 41**, `uxuR`, 1.31 bits, in a region of plasticity in 36% of calls. The 46 columns where most calls are in a region of plasticity are named 80% and cost 0.88 bits; the other 34 are named 88% and cost 0.59 bits. Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside, 1.21 against 0.37 bits, and names fewer genes, 71% against 94%.

**The window ends in variable columns 57 to 71**, in 4 to 47% of chromosomes, then `ytgA` to `ahr` at columns 72 to 79. The `fim` genes, [[type 1 fimbria assembly]], and `nanC` and `nanM` sit in the fork and variable columns before them.

label: osmY
facts:
WINDOW: the osmY window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor osmY, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,744 to 3,823 from dnaA. Read in 537 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying osmY once); 42,960 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 83% of genes, 0.76 bits on average (perplexity 2.2 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 20,013 calls, named 95%, 0.21 bits; shell 21,761 calls, named 76%, 1.14 bits; cloud 1,186 calls, named 15%, 3.10 bits. Outside an RGP 23,090 calls, named 94%, 0.37 bits; inside an RGP 19,870 calls, named 71%, 1.21 bits. Columns: 18 spine, 35 fork, 27 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.21 against 0.37 bits) and names fewer genes (71% against 94%); 19,870 of the 42,960 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 41 (uxuR) 1.31 bits, RGP 36%; column 59 ("DUF957 domain-containing protein") 1.25 bits, RGP 56%; column 40 ("hypothetical protein") 1.23 bits, RGP 37%. The 46 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 80%, 0.88 bits on average; the other 34 columns: named 88%, 0.59 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 19 (spine), RGP 56%; the least: columns 0-16 (spine), RGP 0-17%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-16 (17 columns) spine: share 91-100%, all P, RGP 0-17%. Genes: osmY, prfC, yjjG "pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase", rimI, holD, rsmC, yjjZ "DUF1435 family protein", fhuF, bglJ, yjjQ "helix-turn-helix domain-containing…", yjjP "threonine/serine ThrE exporter fami…", yjjB "threonine/serine exporter", dnaT "DnaT-like ssDNA-binding domain-cont…", dnaC, yjjA "DUF2501 domain-containing protein Y…", opgB, lgoD "L-galactonate oxidoreductase". named 18-100% (mean 90%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 9 (yjjQ), named 18%, 0.93 bits.
2. columns 17-18 (2 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 55-56%. named 87-88% (mean 87%), fewest named at column 17, named 87%; most hesitant at column 18, 0.95 bits.
   17 variable: lgoR S 86%
   18 fork: lgoT S 73%; also "cation:proton antiporter" S 14%
3. column 19 spine: share 91%, all P, RGP 56%. Genes: tsr. named 87%; 0.57 bits.
4. columns 20-79 (60 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 34-70%. named 69-93% (mean 81%), fewest named at column 20, named 69%; most hesitant at column 41, 1.31 bits.
   a second branch of 11 families through columns 20-30, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 28-33%, all S; the branch's families: hpaR, hpaG, hpaE, hpaD, "5-carboxymethyl-2-hydroxymuconate Delta…", hpaH, hpaI, hpaX, hpaA, hpaB, "4-hydroxyphenylacetate 3-monooxygenase…"
